project.name: osgi/domains/incus/incus-port
project.description: The incus domain's seam: the IncusInstanceContact verb (is a launched instance reachable, checked by running a trivial command on it) and its flat IncusExecRequest record. The incus-edge satisfies it by shelling `ssh … incus exec`; the host readiness gate composes it, keeping the retry loop and the ObservationView projection. type=seam: system-exported, one shared copy across the host↔bundle boundary, like every -port.
